segments.contextAfter: `trust`: The trust management object containing the certificate you want to evaluate. A trust management object includes the certificate to be verified plus the policy or policies to be used in evaluating trust. It can optionally also include other certificates to be used in verifying the first certificate. Use the [`SecTrustCreateWithCertificates(_:_:_:)`](sectrustcreatewithcertificates(_:_:_:).md) function to create a trust management object.
